Egypt — Siwa Oasis

About the Brand

From the Heart of
Siwa Oasis

Alshehne Dates is an Egyptian dates store sourcing its premium products directly from the Siwa Oasis — one of Egypt's most ancient and celebrated agricultural regions, renowned for its rich, high-quality dates in multiple varieties.

The brand needed an identity that honors this deep-rooted heritage while speaking to a modern Egyptian consumer market.

The Brief

Heritage, Craft &
Natural Elegance

Design a brand identity that authentically represents the Siwa Oasis — its desert landscape, ancient palm trees, salt lakes, and rich Siouan heritage — while communicating premium quality and building trust with Egyptian consumers.

Challenge

Create a brand that stands apart in a crowded dates market — one that feels rooted in place and story, not generic food branding. The identity had to work bilingually and resonate with both traditional and modern buyers.

Solution

A palm tree mark built from four symbolic branches — each representing a key element of Siwa: the desert, dates, salt lakes, and Siouan heritage. Rich earthy tones grounded in the landscape, paired with elegant typography that bridges Arabic and English.

Logo System

The Palm Mark —
Four Elements, One Symbol

The logo is inspired by the palm tree of Siwa Oasis. Its four branches each represent a defining element of the brand's origin: the desert, dates, the salt lakes, and the ancient Siouan heritage — unified in a single, elegant mark.

Color Palette

Colors of the
Desert & Oasis

The palette draws from the natural landscape of Siwa — deep forest greens of the palm groves, warm desert golds, rich earth tones of dried dates, and the burnt clay of ancient Siwan architecture.

Brand Elements

A Complete
Visual System

Logo Variations

Vertical and horizontal layouts — ensuring the mark works across all applications from packaging to digital.

Brand Pattern

A repeating pattern derived from the logo mark — inspired by traditional Siwan textile motifs, used across packaging and collateral.

Brand Applications

The identity applied across business cards and print materials — consistent, premium, and rooted in the brand's earthy palette.
